title: Keyword Research output
description: Canonical shape for keyword-research.json produced by pod-1B-keyword-research. Consumed by pod-1A-entity-research, pod-1C-virality-research, the N-Gram Table, the Topic Planner, and Run of Show (which reads the search_queries array verbatim for its Appendix). If a field is added/renamed/reordered, edit this schema first, then update SKILL.md prose. Bump version and append to version_history on every change.

version_history.change: Initial schema. Captures topic, scope, location, keywords (with msv/kd/cpc/intent/serp_features/data_source/prominence_filter), seed_keywords, paa_stacks, related_searches, search_queries handoff array, localization block, provenance.

Geo model alignment (Gabe directive, Whalen scoping). Added targeting_strategy (single-location/multi-location) and optimization_scope (City/State/County/Regional show anchor) fields; clarified location as the Episode geo target. Canonical three-field geo model: Targeting strategy / Optimization scope (show anchor) / Episode geo target. Rule: anchor scope != per-episode target - research pulls at the anchor breadth AND per target city.

Provenance enum drift fix (surfaced by Whalen wrongful-death run: 100% Keywords Everywhere volume could not validate). Added 'keywords_everywhere_gkp' to provenance.data_source enum to mirror the per-row keywords[].data_source enum (aligned 2026-06-08). A run whose volume is entirely KE-GKP now validates instead of being mislabeled 'mixed'/'ahrefs'.

scope.description: Which generation scope this keyword set was produced at (breadth of the artifact). Distinct from the geo model fields below.

targeting_strategy.description: Geo model field 1. Whether the firm serves/ranks one city (single-location) or several (multi-location). Single-location anchors every episode on the one city; multi-location anchors the show broad (usually State/Regional) and targets a different city per episode.

optimization_scope.description: Geo model field 2 - the show anchor. What the podcast as a whole is optimized to rank for. Governs the overall keyword-research breadth (the keyword pass runs at this scope). Distinct from the per-episode Episode geo target (the 'location' field): anchor scope != per-episode target.

location.description: Geo model field 3 - the Episode geo target: the specific city an episode is built to rank for and whose location-variant keywords it reads downstream. State-prefixed jurisdictional folder name when scope is Location or Extension (e.g., 'CA - Long Beach'). Null otherwise. No colons; dashes only. The show anchor (optimization_scope) governs research breadth; this field selects the episode's target city - anchor scope != per-episode target.

keywords.description: The full ranked keyword set, 150-300 rows.

serp_features.description: SERP features present (PAA, video, featured snippet, local pack).

data_source.description: Per-row provenance tag. A single keyword set can mix all four. keywords_everywhere_gkp is the primary real-volume source (added v3.0.0 prose; enum aligned 2026-06-08).

prominence_filter.description: Set to 'low' when a high-MSV term does not align with the practice area's semantic core (Editorial Guideline 2). Never removed, only flagged.

seed_keywords.description: The 10-20 anchor seed keywords the full set expanded from.

paa_stacks.description: People Also Ask stacks, one per seed keyword. PAA questions preserved verbatim.

seed.description: The seed keyword this PAA stack belongs to.

paa_source.description: Where the PAA stack came from. llm_inferred is the last-resort fallback.

related_searches.description: 100-200 related search phrases surfaced across all seeds.

search_queries.description: The ~20-row Search Queries & Volume handoff table. Read verbatim by Run of Show for its Appendix. Ordered descending by monthly_volume.

query.description: The FULL user-typed query, not the seed keyword.

source.description: Data source tag for this row. keywords_everywhere_gkp added 2026-06-08 to align with v3.0.0 KE-primary prose.

localization.description: Localization A/B result. Null when scope is Topic / Topic Only.

ratio.description: Local MSV / generic MSV. 10-30% is normal.

intent_flips.description: Keywords where the location modifier flipped the intent bucket.
